method: Examine intersection edges of both faces, comparing all new pairs against the rest mesh and tracing external visibility at nine headings. Render the exact geometry and actual input-driven frame from the gameplay camera; evaluated seams described below. Segment length is the length along two crossing surfaces, not penetration depth. The late-trial helper ring and rigid attachments are tracked against original IDs.

observations.right_cuff_0.0917_s: White outer fleece is continuous in side/rear/three-quarter views. The earlier externally visible trouser wedge is gone.
observations.actual_camera_471: Mobile-camera zooms and isolated leg show the welt staying intact as the leg settles. The dark tongue/purple knee pad remains above the cream trim.
observations.field_0.0417_s: The orange coat touches the top rear of the raised boot. In the textured render the two retain complete distinct silhouettes.
observations.field_0.325_s_and_native_443: The geometric maxima are on a bent navy trouser and its folds. Gameplay frames and isolated closeups show a continuous colored surface without an exposed edge, z-fighting or a detached garment island.
observations.steady_native_209: The outside upper stud looks oval from the true gameplay angle. Its own geometry retains its dimensions and its projected relief from the original leather is about 1.4–3.0 mm across the field cycle. The normal and 2x gameplay frames are attached.
